name: FP25R12W2T4
title: FP25R12W2T4: 1200 V, 25 A IGBT power-integrated module with three-phase rectifier, brake chopper, three-phase inverter and NTC
summary: A power-integrated module holding a complete motor-drive power stage: a 1600 V three-phase diode rectifier bridge, a 1200 V brake chopper (one IGBT with its free-wheel diode), a 1200 V, 25 A three-phase IGBT inverter with anti-parallel diodes, and an NTC thermistor for case temperature. The rectifier output (P, N) and the inverter bus (P1 and the three low-side emitters EU, EV, EW) come out on separate pins. Internal isolation is Al2O3, tested at 2.5 kV rms for one minute; the data are preliminary.

operation.text: Three AC lines L1, L2, L3 feed a six-diode bridge whose positive rail is P and negative rail N. The inverter has three half-bridges between P1 and the separate low-side emitter pins EU, EV, EW; their mid-points are U, V and W. High-side gates are G1 (U), G3 (V), G5 (W), low-side gates G2 (U), G4 (V), G6 (W). Each of the six inverter IGBTs has a diode across it, cathode to collector; the brake-chopper IGBT has none. The brake chopper is an IGBT from B to NB with gate GB, and a diode from B to P1. The thermistor sits between T1 and T2.
Each connector pin carries at most 30 A rms in continuous operation; the main power connections are doubled pins.

Switching figures for the inverter IGBT are characterised with a ±15 V gate drive and 20 Ω turn-on and turn-off resistors; those for the chopper IGBT with ±15 V and 68 Ω. The gate-emitter voltage must stay within ±20 V. There is no internal gate resistor (RGint = 0 Ω).

Junction-to-case resistance is 0.85 K/W max per IGBT, 1.20 K/W per inverter diode, 1.15 K/W per rectifier diode and 1.90 K/W per chopper diode. Case-to-heatsink figures assume a paste or grease of 1 W/(m·K). The junction-to-heatsink transient impedance of the inverter IGBT and of the inverter diode follows a four-term series of ri and τi.
The module is pressed onto the heatsink by clamps, 40 N to 80 N each. A tab with a hole stands out at each end of the housing; the two holes are 53 mm apart.
